items.summary: Reject this cycle’s proposed affiliate prototype and security report. Revenue, lift, ROI, margin, and causal claims are unsupported by low-volume telemetry and partial aggregate attribution; existing execution, repair, and measurement backlogs make new queue work premature. Preserve the native page-local hypothesis for later review after backlog clearance, using existing instrumentation only and a defined measurement gate. No production change, telemetry request, dependency, credential, configuration, spending, schedule, or external outreach is authorized.
